evidence.retrieval_matrix: 3 corpus sizes x 4 batch sizes; 100k uses 2 warmups and 20 timed samples; latency samples occur before a separate single tracemalloc memory sample

evidence.retrieval_receipt: Structured JSON metrics and complexity probes are written to RAG_BENCHMARK_RECEIPT when set; default path is inside pytest tmp_path
evidence.reranker_probe: 2 warmups + 20 unique queries over 16 candidates; computed count checked to exclude pair-cache hits; model/backend/device/p50/p95/min/max emitted; peak memory explicitly not measured
evidence.reranker_threshold: No p50/p95 threshold is specified by the current plan; record measured budget without inventing one

validation: Read-only source inspection only; no benchmark or tests run.
